column1: AUTOMATED FACTOR-SEARCH FRAMEWORK - findings & honest recalibration
WHAT IT DOES: two-stage search. Stage 1 = cheap Ridge ranks hundreds of factor combos. Stage 2 =
rigorous XGBoost non-overlapping validation on finalists. Overfitting guard: judge by the DISTRIBUTION
of top finalists, not the single best (which is inflated by how many combos were searched).
KEY HONEST FINDING: earlier single-model results (1.45% @15d, 1.32% @60d) were OPTIMISTIC -
cherry-picked after the fact. Proper search reveals the real edge is smaller and concentrated at 30-60d.
RECALIBRATED EDGE (post-search, honest):
15d: NO reliable edge over persistence (2.16% vs 1.93%) - just use today price
30d: modest real edge - best model zone
60d: modest real edge (~3.7-4.0% vs persistence 4.3%)
90d: pending full search run (needs more compute)
ROBUSTLY RECURRING FACTORS (appear in nearly all top combos = real signal):
macd_hist, lag_1, roll_std_10 (core), + turkey_scrap_trend20, rsi_14, margin_proxy (frequent)
-> Technical momentum (MACD) earning a place was an unexpected, useful discovery.
SCALING PLAN (needs dedicated compute - run as Cowork scheduled weekly job):
1. All 4 horizons, combos up to size 6-7, full ~20-factor library (+ ingot trend once tracked)
2. Expand models: LightGBM, ElasticNet, quantile-regression-forests (direct band prediction)
3. True hold-out: last ~3 months never touched during search
4. Deflated metrics (Lopez de Prado) - discount by number of combos searched
5. Track factor stability week-over-week: stable winners = real; churning = overfit

KEY DISCOVERY: model edge GROWS with horizon (opposite of naive intuition).
Economic logic: fundamental factors (coking coal, Turkey scrap, margin) act SLOWLY, so they
add most value over months. Short-term: use persistence. Long-term (60-90d): fundamentals lead.
90d winner: coking_coal_trend + turkey_scrap_trend + lag_1 + macd_hist

VERDICT: 90d edge is REAL and ROBUST - ~2.8-3.0% across 4 tree models, HALVING persistence error (5.5%).
The single-combo 1.19% was optimistic; ~2.8% is the honest, model-agnostic number. Nonlinearity confirmed necessary (linear lags).
BATCH 7 - QUANTILE BANDS + CALIBRATION TEST (definitive answer on band width):
Tight quantile-forest bands (Rs 440-670 wide) were TESTED and FAIL: "80% band" actually covers only ~40% of outcomes.
A Rs 500-1000 band at 60-90d would be right <50% of the time. Honest 80% coverage needs ~Rs 2000-3000 width.
CONCLUSION: tight bands are impossible on this market (tested, not assumed). BUT point forecast is still good
(~2.8% @90d, halves persistence). Use DIRECTION + level, not precise band. Market genuinely swings Rs 3000+/quarter.
